settings.title: Steering wheel voice button
settings.description: Which press Car Check takes. The other one stays the car's: a long press is the phone's assistant while Android Auto or CarPlay is on.

options.title: Press: phone assistant (Android Auto/CarPlay), stays open after you let go
Press: phone assistant; hold: phone assistant that ends when you let go
Press: Car Check notice (the long press stays the phone's assistant)
Hold: Car Check notice (a press stays the car's assistant)
